data.one_liner: Wrapper for the Web Serial API to use serial ports in Flutter web.
data.what_it_does: Provides a thin Dart wrapper around window.navigator.serial so you can request, open, read from, and write to serial ports from Flutter web. It exposes the native streaming APIs without requiring custom JavaScript.
use_when: You need to communicate with serial devices from a Flutter web app
You want a zero‑JS, out‑of‑the‑box solution for the Web Serial API
avoid_when: Your app targets mobile or desktop platforms
You require advanced serial features not exposed by the browser API
strengths: Uses native streaming APIs for read/write
weaknesses: Web‑only, no support for other platforms
Limited to the capabilities of the browser's Serial API
data.setup_notes: Run the app over HTTPS (secure context) to access serial ports; no native setup required.
